newsitem.title: JAPAN: Wrestler swaps sumo ring for hustings.
newsitem.headline: Wrestler swaps sumo ring for hustings.

text.p: A heavyweight candidate has entered the fray in Japan's general election to be held on October 20: a top sumo wrestler.
Kyokudozan, known for his speedy grappling style in the ring, will stand for the main opposition Shinshinto (New Frontier Party), the Kyodo news agency reported on Sunday.
He will submit his resignation to the Japan Sumo Association on Monday, Kyodo said.
Kyokudozan, 31, had a 6-9 record in last month's Autumn Grand Sumo Tournament and held the rank of No. 9 maegashira in professional sumo's first division.
Kyokudozan, whose real name is Kazuyasu Hata, will be placed on the party's proportional representation list in the western Kinki bloc.
Shinshinto, led by maverick politician Ichiro Ozawa, has also nominated the popular wife of a professional baseball manager, Sachiyo Nomura, to run in Tokyo in the October 20 polls.
